description.zh: 62 个田园图标，分为花园菜圃、农场劳作、乡野风光、农场动物与丰收餐桌五类：草帽、风车、谷仓、奶牛、绵羊、山羊、马、蜂巢、玉米、手推车、彩虹、南瓜、苹果派等。透明底，外轮廓随页面变色（currentColor），麦金、叶绿、陶土红与奶油色平涂，加上明暗、高光和草编、木纹、砖瓦等质感。每个图标自带 pastoral-<id>- 前缀的轻柔 CSS 动画（漂浮 / 摇摆 / 旋转 / 呼吸 / 弹跳），可由宿主暂停，并尊重减少动态效果设置。80×80 画布，单文件自包含，可直接内联。
description.en: 62 countryside icons in five groups (garden, farm work, countryside, farm animals and the harvest table), from straw hat, windmill and barn to cow, sheep, goat, horse, beehive, corn, wheelbarrow, rainbow, pumpkin and apple pie. Transparent ground with outlines that follow the page color (currentColor), flat wheat gold, leaf green, terracotta and cream fills with shading, highlights and textures such as weave, wood grain and tiles. Each icon ships a gentle pastoral-<id>- prefixed CSS animation (float / sway / spin / pulse / pop) that the host can pause and that honors prefers-reduced-motion. 80×80 viewBox, self-contained single files ready to inline.

description.zh: 宽檐编织草帽，帽顶有交叉草编纹，陶土色帽带垂下一段飘带，侧边别着小雏菊，轻轻漂浮。用于夏日、田园生活与户外主题。
description.en: Wide-brimmed straw hat with a cross-woven crown, a terracotta band with a trailing ribbon and a tucked-in daisy, gently floating. For summer, farm life and outdoor themes.

description.zh: 叶绿色铁皮洒水壶，双提手、壶身小花贴纸，黄铜喷头洒下三滴水。用于园艺、照料与成长。
description.en: Leaf-green tin watering can with two handles and a little flower decal, three drops falling from its brass rose. For gardening, care and growth.

description.zh: 饱满的橙色胡萝卜，侧面带阴影和横纹，四片羽状绿叶在顶部张开，整根随风摇摆。用于蔬菜、收获与健康饮食。
description.en: Plump orange carrot with side shading, ridge lines and four feathery leaves fanning out on top, swaying as a whole. For vegetables, harvest and healthy food.

description.zh: 两层金色花瓣的向日葵，褐色花盘布满种子点，长在两片叶子的茎上左右点头。用于夏天、阳光与快乐。
description.en: Sunflower with two layers of golden petals and a seed-dotted brown disk on a two-leaf stem, nodding side to side. For summer, sunshine and happiness.

description.zh: 两层白色花瓣围着金黄花心缓缓转动，叶片上停着一只小瓢虫。用于春天、清新与小确幸。
description.en: Two rings of white petals slowly turning around a golden heart, with a tiny ladybird resting on a leaf. For spring, freshness and simple joys.

description.zh: 红色圆伞盖缀着奶油色斑点，伞下有菌褶，旁边冒出一朵小蘑菇，草丛中轻快弹起。用于林地、采集与童趣。
description.en: Round red cap with cream spots and gills underneath, a little sibling sprouting beside it, popping up among the grass. For forest floors, foraging and whimsy.

description.zh: 奶油色木板风车塔，红色塔顶、环形平台和拱门，四片格栅风帆在花草小丘上稳稳转动。用于能源、乡村与四季流转。
description.en: Cream plank windmill with a red cap, a gallery and an arched door, four lattice sails turning steadily above a flowered hill. For energy, countryside and the turning of seasons.

description.zh: 柳条编织篮，扭绳篮沿和缠绕提手，五枚白色与浅褐色鸡蛋堆在上面，一角露出红布。用于早餐、新鲜农产与农夫市集。
description.en: Wicker basket with a twisted rim and a wrapped handle, five white and light-brown eggs piled on top and a red cloth peeking out. For breakfast, fresh produce and farm markets.

description.zh: 三株金色麦穗用陶土色丝带扎成一束，颗粒饱满、麦芒细长，配两片麦叶一起摇曳。用于谷物、面包、丰收与秋天。
description.en: Three golden wheat ears tied into a sheaf with a terracotta bow, plump grains and fine awns, swaying with two blades of leaf. For grain, bread, harvest and autumn.

description.zh: 金属牛奶罐，圆顶盖、两侧提手和蓝色腰带，正面椭圆标签上画着一滴牛奶。用于乳制品、早餐与新鲜农产。
description.en: Metal milk churn with a domed lid, side handles and a blue band, an oval label with a milk drop on the front. For dairy, breakfast and fresh farm goods.

description.zh: 木柄三齿干草叉斜插在一堆干草上，叉身轻轻摆动。用于农活、晒草与农场劳作。
description.en: Wooden three-tine pitchfork stuck into a heap of hay, its shaft gently rocking. For chores, hay making and farm work.

description.zh: 红色木板谷仓，复折式深色屋顶、白色镶边、交叉大门和装着干草的阁楼窗，轻柔呼吸。用于农场、仓储与大本营。
description.en: Red plank barn with a dark gambrel roof, white trim, crossed doors and a hay-filled loft window, breathing softly. For farms, storage and home base.

description.zh: 两根尖顶木门柱之间的乡村田间门，三道横栏加斜撑、铁铰链和门闩，门柱旁野花随风摇摆。用于入口、边界与欢迎。
description.en: Rustic field gate between two pointed posts, three rails with a diagonal brace, iron hinges and a latch, wildflowers swaying by the post. For entrances, boundaries and welcome.

description.zh: 戴草帽的稻草人，麻布脸缝着笑容，格子衬衫打着补丁，袖口露出稻草，手臂上还停着一只小乌鸦，轻轻摇摆。用于田野、丰收与秋日趣味。
description.en: Straw-hatted scarecrow with a stitched burlap smile, a patched plaid shirt and straw poking from the cuffs, a little crow perched on one arm, swaying. For fields, harvest and autumn fun.

description.zh: 奶油色小屋，陶土瓦屋顶、拱顶木门和挂着花箱的窗，红砖烟囱冒出缕缕轻烟。用于家园、舒适与乡村生活。
description.en: Cream cottage with a terracotta tiled roof, an arched wooden door and a window box of flowers, soft smoke drifting from the brick chimney. For home, comfort and village life.

description.zh: 黄褐色仓鸮，白色心形脸盘、斑点翅膀和奶油色胸羽，栖在带叶的枝头，身体轻轻起伏。用于夜晚、智慧与静静守望。
description.en: Tawny barn owl with a white heart-shaped face, speckled wings and a cream breast, perched on a leafy branch and gently breathing. For night, wisdom and quiet watch.

description.zh: 陶土花盆里冒出一株两叶幼苗，叶尖挂着一滴水，盆边插着小标签，嫩芽轻轻摇摆。用于播种、新开始与成长。
description.en: A two-leaf seedling sprouting from a terracotta pot, a water drop by its leaf and a plant tag in the soil, the sprout gently swaying. For sowing, new beginnings and growth.

description.zh: 绑在木桩上的番茄藤，挂着红、橙、青三颗番茄，绿色萼片与叶片随风轻摆。用于菜园、夏季收获与新鲜食材。
description.en: A tomato vine tied to a wooden stake, hanging red, orange and green tomatoes with starry calyxes and leaves, swaying lightly. For kitchen gardens, summer harvest and fresh food.

description.zh: 复古红色小拖拉机，大后轮、小前轮、奶油色顶篷和蓝色车窗，排气管冒烟，车身随路面轻轻颠动。用于耕作、农机与乡村出行。
description.en: Vintage red tractor with a big rear wheel, a small front wheel, a cream canopy and a blue window, puffing from its exhaust as the body bobs over the field. For ploughing, farm machinery and country rides.

description.zh: 用两道麻绳捆好的方形干草捆，三面不同明暗的草纹，边角支出几根稻草，顶上站着一只小麻雀。用于晒草、储料与秋天。
description.en: Square hay bale bound with two twine bands, straw texture shaded on three faces, a few strands poking out and a little sparrow perched on top. For hay making, fodder and autumn.

description.zh: 圆润的双色树冠缀满红苹果，粗壮树干分出两根枝杈，树下落着一红一黄两颗果子，树冠轻轻摇摆。用于果园、四季与丰收。
description.en: Rounded two-tone canopy full of red apples on a sturdy forked trunk, one red and one yellow apple fallen beneath, the crown gently swaying. For orchards, seasons and harvest.

description.zh: 谷仓屋顶的小塔楼上立着铜绿色公鸡风向标，箭头和公鸡随风轻摆，下方是方位横杆。用于天气、风向与农家屋顶。
description.en: A verdigris rooster weathervane on a barn-roof cupola, the arrow and rooster swinging in the wind above the direction bar. For weather, wind and farmhouse rooftops.

description.zh: 圆形取景里的田园晨景：太阳从层层绿丘和麦田后升起，光芒缓缓旋转，远处有两棵小树和飞鸟。用于清晨、希望与田园风景。
description.en: A round country vignette: the sun rising behind layered green hills and a furrowed wheat field, its rays slowly turning, with two little trees and birds in the distance. For mornings, hope and rural landscapes.

description.zh: 石砌水井配陶土瓦顶、木架和摇柄，木桶挂在绳上轻轻摇晃。用于水源、村落与旧时光。
description.en: Stone well with a terracotta tiled roof, a timber frame and a crank, its wooden bucket swinging gently on the rope. For water, villages and the old days.

description.zh: 正面的黑白花奶牛，粉色口鼻、奶油色小角、额前一撮毛，脖子上挂着金色牛铃，轻轻呼吸。用于牧场、乳制品与可爱动物。
description.en: Front-facing spotted cow with a pink muzzle, cream horns and a forelock tuft, a golden bell on its collar, breathing softly. For pastures, dairy and cute animals.

description.zh: 奶油色卷毛绵羊，深色小脸和四条细腿，脖子上系着小铃铛，在草地上轻轻跳起。用于羊毛、牧场与安眠。
description.en: Fluffy cream sheep with a dark little face and four slim legs, a tiny bell at its neck, bouncing lightly on the grass. For wool, pastures and sleepy nights.

description.zh: 粉色小猪侧身站着，圆鼻头、竖起的耳朵和卷尾巴，背上沾着一块泥点，开心地蹦一下。用于农场动物、可爱与储蓄。
description.en: Pink piglet standing side-on with a round snout, perky ears and a curly tail, a smudge of mud on its back, giving a happy little hop. For farm animals, cuteness and savings.

description.zh: 红棕色母鸡，鲜红鸡冠、肉垂和三色尾羽，身旁跟着一只黄色小鸡，母鸡轻轻一蹦。用于鸡蛋、农家院子与亲子。
description.en: Russet hen with a bright red comb, wattle and three-tone tail feathers, a yellow chick by her side as she gives a little hop. For eggs, farmyards and family.

description.zh: 白色鸭子和橙色扁嘴，在带波纹的蓝色池塘上漂浮，旁边一片睡莲叶托着粉色小花。用于池塘、夏天与悠闲。
description.en: White duck with an orange bill bobbing on a rippled blue pond, beside a lily pad holding a pink blossom. For ponds, summer and lazy days.

description.zh: 浅棕色兔子侧坐着，长耳朵内侧粉色，白色毛球尾巴，粉鼻头和胡须，轻轻一跳。用于春天、菜园访客与可爱动物。
description.en: Fawn rabbit sitting side-on with pink-lined long ears, a white cotton tail, a pink nose and whiskers, giving a small hop. For spring, garden visitors and cute animals.

description.zh: 一圈圈草绳盘成的圆顶蜂巢放在木台上，拱门入口边停着一只蜜蜂，另一只沿虚线轨迹在上方飞舞。用于蜂蜜、勤劳与花园授粉。
description.en: Dome skep beehive coiled from straw rope on a wooden stand, one bee resting by the arched entrance and another hovering above along a dotted trail. For honey, hard work and pollination.

description.zh: 三瓣饱满的橙色南瓜，带木质瓜柄、卷曲藤须和一片叶子，从地面弹起。用于秋天、丰收节与万圣节。
description.en: Plump three-lobed orange pumpkin with a woody stem, a curly tendril and a leaf, popping up from the ground. For autumn, harvest festivals and Halloween.

description.zh: 烤得金黄的乡村面包，四道割口露出浅色内里，表面撒着面粉，放在带挂孔的木砧板上，旁边一小枝麦穗。用于烘焙、早餐与家常饭食。
description.en: Golden country loaf with four scored cuts showing pale crumb and a dusting of flour, resting on a wooden board with a hanging hole and a small wheat sprig. For baking, breakfast and home cooking.

description.zh: 金色蜂蜜装在玻璃罐里，红白格子布盖着罐口并用麻绳扎好，六边形标签画着小蜜蜂，旁边斜插木蜂蜜勺。用于甜食、早餐与农家产品。
description.en: A glass jar of golden honey under a red gingham cloth tied with twine, a hexagon label with a little bee and a wooden dipper leaning in. For sweets, breakfast and farm goods.

description.zh: 带橙色外皮的大块楔形奶酪，切面布满气孔，前面还切下一小片。用于乳制品、野餐与农家美食。
description.en: A big wedge of cheese with an orange rind and holes across the cut face, a small slice already cut in front. For dairy, picnics and farmhouse food.

description.zh: 木板条箱里堆满红、青、黄苹果，箱面印着苹果标记，顶上一片绿叶。用于果园收获、集市与新鲜水果。
description.en: A slatted wooden crate piled with red, green and yellow apples, an apple mark stamped on the front and a green leaf on top. For orchard harvests, markets and fresh fruit.

description.zh: 白色山羊，弯弯的灰角、小胡子和颈下金铃，正侧身站在草地上，头部轻轻摆动。用于牧场、山野与可爱动物。
description.en: White goat with curved grey horns, a little beard and a golden neck bell, standing side-on in the grass while its head gently sways. For pastures, hillsides and cute animals.

description.zh: 棕色农场马，深色鬃毛和尾巴，额前一道白斑，颈部和头轻轻摆动。用于牧场、骑乘与乡村生活。
description.en: Brown farm horse with a dark mane and tail and a white blaze, its neck and head gently swaying. For ranches, riding and country life.

description.zh: 灰色小毛驴，长耳朵内侧粉色，背上搭着红色条纹毯，头和耳朵轻轻摆动。用于乡间运输、牧场与温顺动物。
description.en: Grey donkey with long pink-lined ears and a striped red saddle blanket, head and ears gently swaying. For country transport, farms and gentle animals.

description.zh: 昂首的公鸡，红色鸡冠和肉垂、金色颈羽、橙色翅膀和墨绿长尾羽，头颈轻轻摆动。用于清晨、报晓与农家院落。
description.en: Proud rooster with a red comb and wattle, golden neck feathers, an orange wing and long dark green tail plumes, its head and neck swaying. For dawn, wake-up calls and farmyards.

description.zh: 长脖子大白鹅，橙色喙和脚掌，颈上系着淡蓝蝴蝶结，轻快地蹦一下。用于农家院子、池塘与童趣主题。
description.en: Long-necked white goose with an orange bill and feet and a pale blue bow on its neck, giving a little hop. For farmyards, ponds and playful themes.

description.zh: 黑白相间的牧羊犬，竖耳、粉舌头，戴红色项圈和金色名牌，尾巴快乐地摇动。用于放牧、看家与忠诚伙伴。
description.en: Black-and-white sheepdog with perked ears, a pink tongue, a red collar and gold tag, wagging its tail happily. For herding, guarding and loyal companions.

description.zh: 金黄玉米棒，颗粒排列整齐，两侧浅绿苞叶和长叶片，顶上几缕玉米须，轻轻摇摆。用于夏收、蔬菜与农作物。
description.en: Golden ear of corn with neat kernel rows, pale green husks and long leaves, a few silk strands on top, gently swaying. For summer harvest, vegetables and crops.

description.zh: 层层包裹的绿色卷心菜，外叶有叶脉，旁边一只小蜗牛，菜心轻轻呼吸。用于菜园、蔬菜与健康饮食。
description.en: Layered green cabbage with veined outer leaves and a small snail beside it, softly breathing. For vegetable gardens, greens and healthy food.

description.zh: 红草莓上点缀浅色籽粒，顶着绿色萼片和小茎，旁边开一朵白色小花，轻轻摇摆。用于春夏水果、采摘与甜点。
description.en: Red strawberry dotted with pale seeds, a green calyx and stem, with a small white blossom beside it, gently swaying. For spring and summer fruit, picking and desserts.

description.zh: 饱满的紫色茄子，绿色萼帽和弯茎，旁边一片叶子，轻轻摇摆。用于菜园、蔬菜与烹饪。
description.en: Plump purple eggplant with a green cap and curved stem next to a leaf, gently swaying. For vegetable gardens, produce and cooking.

description.zh: 裂开的绿色豌豆荚，露出四颗圆滚滚的豌豆，末端带一圈卷须，轻轻漂浮。用于春季菜园、蔬菜与童趣主题。
description.en: Open green pea pod showing four round peas with a curling tendril at the tip, gently floating. For spring gardens, vegetables and playful themes.

description.zh: 浅蓝铁斗的独轮手推车，装满泥土并冒出一棵嫩芽，木把手，前轮缓缓转动。用于园艺、搬运与农场劳作。
description.en: Wheelbarrow with a pale blue steel tray full of soil and a sprouting seedling, wooden handles and a slowly turning front wheel. For gardening, hauling and farm work.

description.zh: 木柄长镰刀，弯曲的灰色刀刃和握把，旁边立着几株麦穗，镰刀轻轻摆动。用于割麦、秋收与农具。
description.en: Wooden scythe with a curved grey blade and grip beside a few stalks of wheat, the scythe gently swinging. For mowing, autumn harvest and farm tools.

description.zh: 木柄铁锹，灰色锹头插进土堆，旁边一条粉色小蚯蚓探出头，锹身轻轻摇摆。用于挖土、园艺与农具。
description.en: Wooden-handled shovel with a grey blade by a soil mound where a pink earthworm peeks out, the shovel gently rocking. For digging, gardening and farm tools.

description.zh: 老式木犁，灰色犁铧和前轮，翻开一道道褐色土垄，犁身轻轻晃动。用于春耕、耕地与传统农业。
description.en: Old wooden plough with a grey share and front wheel turning brown furrows, the plough gently rocking. For spring ploughing, tilling and traditional farming.

description.zh: 木条箍成的黄油搅拌桶，灰色铁箍和盖子，搅棒上下起伏，旁边放着一块黄油。用于乳品、手作与农家厨房。
description.en: Wooden stave butter churn with grey hoops and lid, its dasher bobbing up and down beside a pat of butter. For dairy, handcraft and farmhouse kitchens.

description.zh: 架高的木板鸡舍，红色屋顶和斜坡梯，拱门里一只小白鸡探出头来，轻轻一跳。用于养鸡、农家院子与鸡蛋。
description.en: Raised plank chicken coop with a red roof and ramp, a little white hen popping her head out of the arched door. For poultry, farmyards and eggs.

description.zh: 灰色圆筒粮仓，红色圆顶和侧面铁梯，旁边一间红色小棚屋，天上一只小鸟轻轻飞过。用于粮食储存、农场与乡村天际线。
description.en: Grey grain silo with a red dome and side ladder next to a small red shed, a little bird drifting in the sky. For grain storage, farms and rural skylines.

description.zh: 一朵白色雨云洒下浅蓝雨滴，下方地面冒出一棵小嫩芽，雨滴轻轻飘落。用于天气、春雨与播种季节。
description.en: White rain cloud dropping pale blue raindrops onto the ground where a little sprout appears, the drops gently falling. For weather, spring rain and sowing season.

description.zh: 五色彩虹从两朵白云间升起，彩虹轻轻呼吸。用于雨后天晴、天气与好心情。
description.en: Five-color rainbow rising between two white clouds, gently breathing. For clearing skies after rain, weather and good moods.

description.zh: 浅蓝小池塘，岸边两根香蒲，荷叶上一只小青蛙，旁边一朵粉色睡莲，青蛙轻轻一跳。用于乡野水边、夏天与小动物。
description.en: Small pale blue pond with two cattails, a little frog on a lily pad and a pink water lily, the frog giving a hop. For country waterside, summer and small creatures.

description.zh: 枝叶茂密的橡树，树干上有树洞，树冠挂着橡果，树下坐着一只小松鼠，树冠随风轻摆。用于乡野、秋天与林间动物。
description.en: Leafy oak tree with a knothole in its trunk, acorns in the canopy and a small squirrel at its foot, the crown swaying in the breeze. For countryside, autumn and woodland animals.

description.zh: 刚出炉的苹果派，金黄格子派皮和波浪花边，铁盘盛着，上面热气袅袅。用于烘焙、秋收与家常甜点。
description.en: Freshly baked apple pie with a golden lattice crust and crimped edge in a tin, steam curling above. For baking, autumn harvest and homestyle desserts.

description.zh: 一罐红色果酱，红白格布盖用麻绳扎好，标签上画着樱桃，木勺插在一旁轻轻摆动。用于手作果酱、早餐与农家储藏。
description.en: Jar of red jam with a red-and-white gingham cloth tied with twine, a cherry label and a wooden spoon gently swaying beside it. For homemade preserves, breakfast and pantry.

description.zh: 切开的半个西瓜，红瓤黑籽、浅绿瓜皮，旁边一个条纹整瓜，切片轻轻一跳。用于夏天、解暑与水果。
description.en: Half-cut watermelon with red flesh, black seeds and a pale green rind next to a whole striped melon, the slice giving a hop. For summer, cooling off and fruit.

description.zh: 编织篮里堆着一串紫葡萄，顶上带着藤和一片绿叶，葡萄串轻轻一跳。用于秋收、葡萄园与水果。
description.en: Woven basket holding a bunch of purple grapes with a vine and a green leaf on top, the bunch giving a little hop. For autumn harvest, vineyards and fruit.
